phasm-us-ak-historic-anchorage-hotel/hau.text: The hotel also keeps a guest 'ghost log.' Its official history says travelers have recorded incidents such as curtains and shower curtains moving, objects shifting and unusual presences in corridors and rooms. These are guests’ stories preserved by the hotel in its own collection.

One of the hotel’s pleasures for a paranormal reader is this continuing exchange between past and present. Guests can stay in an operating hotel, see ordinary rooms in an old commercial building and encounter stories that staff preserve as part of the property’s identity.

phasm-us-ak-historic-anchorage-hotel/his.text: After periods of decline and different identities, the annex underwent a revival under new ownership beginning in 1989. Its architecture and role in the city’s development are documented in the National Register nomination for the Anchorage Hotel Annex. The hotel’s public history includes notable early guests and its former function as a gathering place for the young city.

phasm-us-id-old-idaho-penitentiary/intro.text: The Old Idaho Penitentiary has long outlived its original purpose. Its gates now open to visitors instead of closing behind new prisoners, and the weathered buildings reveal the changing ideas of punishment that shaped more than a century of incarceration. They also carry reports of strange voices, touches and persistent unease. The state historical society itself records those stories, naming particular rooms where visitors have described encounters. The stories of the people imprisoned here remain part of the place, alongside the mysteries of the cellblocks.

phasm-us-al-old-cahawba/visiting.text: Old Cahawba’s official plan-your-visit page allows daytime self-guided public exploration and offers guided tours by appointment with advance notice. The park prohibits ordinary nighttime visitation except for authorized special events. Haunted-history tours have been advertised in the past; check for a current announcement before planning around one. The public map pin is at the official visitor center, not at the uncertain position of the Pegues maze.

phasm-us-nv-mackay-mansion/hauntings/1.text: The home has appeared in paranormal television, and its operators connect a reported youthful apparition with actor Johnny Depp’s recollections while in Virginia City. The celebrity association belongs to the operators’ modern retelling.

phasm-us-mo-lemp-mansion/hauntings/1.text: There is also a structured 'Lemp Experience' in which a paranormal guide introduces visitors to observation tools before leading them through several levels of the house. The property presents this as a chance to investigate for oneself; the tools and any readings are part of the organized visitor activity as described by the operator. Ghostly presences are embedded in the setting of an occupied historic business, not isolated in a closed-off ruin.

phasm-us-ma-lizzie-borden-house/haunting.text: Another recorded episode comes from *New England Legends*. Its hosts recount hearing quick footsteps apparently racing from the basement entrance into the kitchen during an investigation. Expecting an intruder, they checked the space and found nobody there. Their retelling identifies a specific location and sequence of events. A *People* magazine overnight investigation in 2024 described motion-sensor and sound incidents reported by the visiting team.

phasm-us-az-bird-cage-theatre/hauntings/.text: The building’s age and the age of its stories differ. An authentic 1880s theater can accumulate paranormal interpretations many decades later. That does not make every figure a known nineteenth-century resident.

phasm-us-oh-historic-prospect-place/haun.text: Prospect Place has its own family legends, many of which touch the nineteenth-century estate and its changing uses. The nonprofit has a research section separating some local stories from archival findings. Such distinctions matter, particularly for stories of missing people, enslaved people, or Underground Railroad activity.

phasm-us-wa-walker-ames-house/hauntings/.text: The stories themselves involve apparitions and unexplained movement or sound in the building. One image on the tour operator’s website, described as a photograph taken during a walk, has been discussed as showing an apparition on the second floor. The apparent figure remains the visitor’s interpretation of the image.

phasm-us-wa-walker-ames-house/history/1.text: Architectural surveys by the Historic American Engineering Record identify it as a highly intact example of company-town domestic architecture. The house stood vacant after the mill closed in the 1990s; local tour organizations have used its history as the setting for narrated walks and scheduled investigations. Port Gamble itself is more than its ghost stories, with a heritage district, cemetery and record of lumber industry, land relations and maritime work alongside its paranormal reputation.

phasm-us-wy-occidental-hotel/hauntings/1.text: In a 2011 paranormal-group report, Black Hills Paranormal Investigations described an invitation from a then-owner to examine the hotel. The report attributes a more elaborate account to the owner: Emily allegedly died of typhoid fever in 1902. That remains an attributed historical claim in an investigator’s report rather than a verified person whose death record has been located.

phasm-us-va-ferry-plantation-house/visit.text: Historical house tours are offered only through the nonprofit’s current booking system, normally with advance reservation. Crucially, its own visitor page says all paranormal nights in 2026 are fully booked and further paranormal inquiries are not being accepted.

phasm-us-ia-edinburgh-manor/hauntings/0.text: Iowa PBS records reports of a little girl who likes to play games and a white-clad woman who suddenly disappears in the building. Other paranormal groups have described giggling, footsteps, moving toys and apparitions near the former patient rooms. The stories are now part of the way investigators encounter the long, institutional corridors, where personal effects and furnishings from the building’s working years remain in place. Visitors and researchers describe these experiences without establishing the figures’ identities.

phasm-us-wa-manresa-castle/hauntings/0.text: Local reporting includes a personal family account: a former hotel housekeeper reportedly set his keys on a table in Room 306, turned away, then saw the ring hovering above the furniture before it fell. Older castle lore tells of Kate, a young woman said to have leapt from a window while grieving a lover, and a Jesuit monk said to haunt the attic over Room 302. These are separate legends, not documented deaths. The housekeeper story comes through a secondhand family recollection.

phasm-us-az-jerome-grand-hotel/hauntings.text: The hotel’s own historical account recalls paranormal visitors who independently described a displeased head nurse in the former dispensary area. The original desks had been moved into storage; when someone later returned them to the dining space, the story says the nurse stopped expressing her displeasure. Other tales have gathered around the old Otis elevator, particularly an alleged maintenance worker named Claude Harvey. Accounts also speak of corridors echoing with voices, breathing and footsteps recalling the building’s hospital years. The named elevator death belongs to local lore; the account does not establish a documented 1935 incident.

phasm-us-tx-yorktown-memorial-hospital/h.text: The building has developed a vivid reputation among investigators. In a 2014 first-person account, paranormal researcher Jason Black described returning three times and experiencing what felt like a push, a touch, and a tug on his shirt. The current operator shares other reports from the wards: dolls that seem to speak on their own, towering shadowy figures, eye-like red lights and footsteps when no one is visible. Such accounts are part of the hospital’s paranormal tradition, distinct from claims about particular patients or historical wrongdoing. The abandoned medical rooms provide a chilling setting for these encounters.

phasm-us-il-mineral-springs-hotel-alton/.text: The Jasmine Lady is said to leave the scent of flowers along the former hotel’s grand stairs. Other accounts center on the downstairs swimming pool, where visitors and ghost researchers have described footsteps, figures and voices. Local paranormal historian Troy Taylor has connected the pool stories to Clarence Blair, a young man whose fatal swimming accident was recorded. Separate stories of several children supposedly drowning belong to local lore, rather than a documented list of deaths. Researchers have documented their visits to the former hotel, including reports of unusual voices and sensations.

phasm-us-ma-harvard-shaker-lollipop-ceme.text: Local folklore describes former Shaker residents glimpsed among the graves and the surrounding fields. What visitors can readily see is equally remarkable: hundreds of narrow iron markers with circular heads that resemble lollipops. The little cemetery is tied to a religious community whose members lived and worked together for generations. The ghost story is a modern local tradition.

phasm-us-pa-farnsworth-house-inn/hauntin.text: The inn’s legends focus on a Confederate sharpshooter in the attic, its old cellar and reports of voices or apparitions within the house. The property’s interpreters connect the upper rooms with a story about the death of Jennie Wade elsewhere in town, though the exact source of the fatal shot remains a local interpretation rather than a conclusively identified gun position. The Farnsworth is not only a backdrop for reenactment; its own operator hosts guided paranormal investigations in preserved rooms.

phasm-us-nc-devils-tramping-ground/visit.text: The Chatham County Historical Association explicitly requests that visits occur only with permission. Visit North Carolina mentions private-property camping arrangements, but this research did not confirm a current authorized booking channel. The exact location is withheld, and no authorized public access has been established.

phasm-us-de-woodburn-governors-residence.text: The State of Delaware says Woodburn tours are currently unavailable, although it may announce special public events. It remains an occupied official residence. Do not approach the house for paranormal investigation or contact its residents.

phasm-us-pa-jennie-wade-house/hauntings/.text: Jennie Wade’s death in July 1863 was a real tragedy: she was struck by a bullet while inside a house during the Battle of Gettysburg. Later tour traditions describe spirits in and around the building, including figures thought to be soldiers and reports of unexplained activity. The museum’s historic tours tell Jennie’s real story, while authorized evening ghost tours explore the paranormal reputation. The two programs offer different experiences and have separate access rules.

phasm-us-mi-morrow-road-woman-in-white/v.text: This is an ordinary road, not a designated viewing attraction. Do not stop on narrow shoulders, block driveways, walk on private land or hunt at night in the carriageway. This listing identifies the general road area and does not identify nearby residences.
